ABOUT THE LAB

Curiosity, rendered.

Fractal Space is an evolving collection of artistic experiments made for the browser. Each work starts with a question: what could this medium do that another medium couldn’t?

Silk / wind makes your movement into an invisible force. Impossible water remembers each touch as a ripple. Afterimage weaves a temporary sculpture from the path of your hand. Electric horizon explores neon landscapes, floating solids, and cursor-driven perspective, inspired by Go Away Robot ↗. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.

Choose “Use arrow keys” or click the artwork to activate keyboard controls. In Silk / wind, arrows move the wind; in Impossible water, arrows aim and space creates a ripple; in Afterimage, arrows draw and space clears; in Electric horizon, left and right steer, up and down change travel speed, and space sends a pulse. Use + or − to zoom. Save a frame to keep a moment, or enter immersive view to give the artwork the whole screen.
